# Game Idea: Cosmic Dodge

**Concept**: The player controls a small spaceship that continuously moves forward through an endless starfield. Asteroids and comets appear from the right side of the screen at varying speeds. The player can move up, down, left, and right to dodge them.

**Lose Condition**: Collision with any asteroid or comet ends the game. Optionally, a timer runs out if the player fails to reach a distance milestone within a set period.

**Core Mechanics**:
- Arrow keys or WASD for movement.
- Simple physics: constant forward scroll, objects move leftward.
- Score based on distance traveled.
- Progressive difficulty: spawn rate and speed increase over time.

**HTML Canvas**: Render starfield background, ship sprite, and asteroid shapes using canvas drawing primitives. Minimal assets required, suitable for a quick prototype.

1: // Minimal "Cosmic Dodge" prototype targeting <canvas id="game">
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas) return; // canvas must exist
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // size canvas to its displayed size
7:   function resize(){
8:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
9:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
10:     initStars();
11:   }
12:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
13:   resize();
14: 
15:   // Player ship (triangle)
16:   const ship = {x:50, y:canvas.height/2, w:20, h:15, speed:3};
17:   const keys = {ArrowUp:false,ArrowDown:false,ArrowLeft:false,ArrowRight:false,W:false,A:false,S:false,D:false};
18:   let audioStarted = false;
19:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key in keys){keys[e.key]=true; if(!audioStarted){audioCtx.resume(); audioStarted=true; }}});
20:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{if(e.key in keys) keys[e.key]=false;});
21: 
22:   // Obstacles (asteroids) array
23:   const asteroids = [];
24:   // Starfield data
25:   const stars = [];
26:   function initStars(){
27:     stars.length = 0;
28:     const count = Math.min(200, canvas.width * canvas.height / 5000 | 0);
29:     for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
30:       stars.push({x:Math.random()*canvas.width, y:Math.random()*canvas.height, bright:Math.random()<0.5});
31:     }
32:   }
33:   // Audio context and simple tone generator
34:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
35:   function playTone(freq, duration){
36:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
37:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
38:     osc.type = 'sine';
39:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
40:     osc.connect(gain);
41:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
42:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
43:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
44:     osc.start();
45:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
46:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
47:   }
48:   let spawnTimer = 0;
49:   let distance = 0;
50:   let gameOver = false;
51: 
52:   function spawnAsteroid(){
53:     const size = Math.random()*30+10;
54:     const y = Math.random()* (canvas.height - size);
55:     const speed = Math.random()*2+2; // leftward speed
56:     asteroids.push({x:canvas.width+size, y, size, speed});
57:   }
58: 
59:   function update(){
60:     if(gameOver) return;
61:     // move ship
62:     let moved = false;
63:     if(keys.ArrowUp||keys.W){ ship.y -= ship.speed; moved = true; }
64:     if(keys.ArrowDown||keys.S){ ship.y += ship.speed; moved = true; }
65:     if(keys.ArrowLeft||keys.A){ ship.x -= ship.speed; moved = true; }
66:     if(keys.ArrowRight||keys.D){ ship.x += ship.speed; moved = true; }
67:     // keep inside canvas
68:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height-ship.h, ship.y));
69:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width-ship.w, ship.x));
70:     // play movement sound (throttle)
71:     if(moved && (audioCtx && audioStarted)){
72:       const now = performance.now();
73:       if(!window.lastMoveSound || now - window.lastMoveSound > 100){ // 100ms debounce
74:         playTone(440, 0.05);
75:         window.lastMoveSound = now;
76:       }
77:     }
78: 
79:     // spawn logic: increase difficulty over time
80:     spawnTimer -= 1;
81:     if(spawnTimer <= 0){
82:       spawnAsteroid();
83:       // faster spawns as distance grows
84:       spawnTimer = Math.max(20, 100 - distance*0.05);
85:     }
86: 
87:     // update asteroids
88:     for(let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
89:       const a = asteroids[i];
90:       a.x -= a.speed;
91:       if(a.x + a.size < 0) asteroids.splice(i,1);
92:     }
93: 
94:     // collision detection (simple AABB)
95:     for(const a of asteroids){
96:       if(ship.x < a.x + a.size && ship.x + ship.w > a.x &&
97:          ship.y < a.y + a.size && ship.y + ship.h > a.y){
98:         gameOver = true;
99:         // play crash sound
100:         if(audioCtx && audioStarted) playTone(150, 0.3);
101:         break;
102:       }
103:     }
104: 
105:     distance += 0.5; // arbitrary distance increment per frame
106:   }
107: 
108: function draw(){
109:     // background gradient (space)
110:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
111:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
112:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
113:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
114:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
115:     // starfield twinkling update
116:     for(const s of stars){
117:       // random twinkle
118:       if(Math.random()<0.02) s.bright = !s.bright;
119:     }
120:     // starfield draw
121:     for(const s of stars){
122:       ctx.fillStyle = s.bright ? '#fff' : '#888';
123:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 2, 2);
124:     }
125:     // ship with gradient
126:     ctx.save();
127:     ctx.translate(ship.x + ship.w/2, ship.y + ship.h/2);
128:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-ship.w/2,0,ship.w/2,0);
129:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
130:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#080');
131:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
132:     ctx.beginPath();
133:     ctx.moveTo(-ship.w/2, 0);
134:     ctx.lineTo(ship.w/2, -ship.h/2);
135:     ctx.lineTo(ship.w/2, ship.h/2);
136:     ctx.closePath();
137:     ctx.fill();
138:     ctx.restore();
139:     // asteroids with irregular polygon
140:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a52a2a';
141:     for(const a of asteroids){
142:       ctx.save();
143:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
144:       ctx.rotate(a.speed * 0.1); // slight rotation based on speed
145:       ctx.beginPath();
146:       const r = a.size/2;
147:       for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
148:         const angle = (i*2*Math.PI)/7;
149:         const rad = r * (0.5 + Math.random()*0.5);
150:         ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(angle)*rad, Math.sin(angle)*rad);
151:       }
152:       ctx.closePath();
153:       ctx.fill();
154:       ctx.restore();
155:     }
156:     // UI
157:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
158:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
159:     ctx.fillText('Distance: '+Math.floor(distance), 10,20);
160:     if(gameOver){
161:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
162:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
163:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
164:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
165:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2);
166:     }
167:   }
168:     // ship
169:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
170:     ctx.beginPath();
171:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h/2);
172:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
173:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
174:     ctx.closePath();
175:     ctx.fill();
176:     // asteroids
177:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a52a2a';
178:     for(const a of asteroids){
179:       ctx.beginPath();
180:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.size/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
181:       ctx.fill();
182:     }
183:     // UI
184:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
185:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
186:     ctx.fillText('Distance: '+Math.floor(distance), 10,20);
187:     if(gameOver){
188:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
189:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
190:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
191:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
192:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2);
193:     }
194:   }
195: 
196:   function loop(){
197:     update();
198:     draw();
199:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
200:   }
201:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
202: })();

(End of file - total 202 lines)
</content>
